headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 reaches 100% matched code, with assembly qualifications
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 report rises from 99.44% to 100.00% matched code. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The result includes assembly-assisted implementations and keeps originally handwritten routines in assembly, while matched data remains at 0.57% (rac1-decomp#135). Going Commando's USA v1.01 rises from 15.46% to 44.26% matched code after large hero-state and smaller-function batches. OpenRAC adds diagnostics recording, Android 9 support and SDK groundwork for headset mods without shipping a VR mod, and restores camera tricks and exiting Giant Clank mode (OpenRAC#75, OpenRAC#77, OpenRAC#82, OpenRAC#80, OpenRAC#81).
